# 1 Enoch Chapter 39 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**39:1** And it shall come to pass in those days that elect and holy children will descend from the high heaven, and their seed will become one with the children of men.

**39:2** In those days Enoch received books of indignation and wrath, and books of disturbance and expulsion. Mercy will not be shown to them, says the Lord of Spirits.

**39:3** At that time a cloud and a whirlwind carried me off from the face of the earth and set me down at the ends of the heavens.

**39:4** And there I saw another vision — the dwelling places of the holy ones and the resting places of the righteous.

**39:5** There my eyes saw their dwellings with his righteous angels and their resting places with the holy ones. They were petitioning and interceding and praying on behalf of the children of men, and righteousness flowed before them like water, and mercy like dew upon the earth; thus it is among them forever and ever.

**39:6** And in that place my eyes saw the Elect One of righteousness and of faith, and righteousness shall prevail in his days, and the righteous and the elect shall be without number before him forever and ever.

**39:7** And I saw his dwelling under the wings of the Lord of Spirits, and all the righteous and the elect before him blazed like fiery lights, and their mouths were full of blessing, and their lips extolled the name of the Lord of Spirits, and righteousness before him shall not fail, and uprightness before him shall not fail.

**39:8** There I wished to dwell, and my spirit longed for that dwelling place, for my portion had been there from before, according to what was established concerning me before the Lord of Spirits.

**39:9** In those days I blessed and extolled the name of the Lord of Spirits with blessing and praise, because he had destined me for blessing and glory in keeping with the good pleasure of the Lord of Spirits.

**39:10** For a long time my eyes fixed upon that place, and I blessed him and praised him, saying: "Blessed is he, and may he be blessed from the beginning and forevermore. Before him there is no end. He knew before the world was created what the world would be, even from generation to generation. Those who sleep not bless you: they stand before your glory and bless and praise and exalt, saying: 'Holy, holy, holy is the Lord of Spirits — he fills the earth with spirits.'"

**39:11** And there my eyes saw all who sleep not, standing before him, blessing and saying: "Blessed are you, and blessed is the name of the Lord forever and ever."

**39:12** And my face was changed, for I could not endure to look.

**39:13** After that I saw a multitude beyond number and reckoning — thousands upon thousands, ten thousand upon ten thousand — standing before the Lord of Spirits. And on the four sides, on the four wings of the Lord of Spirits, I saw others beyond number standing there as well.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Strong consensus on this pivotal chapter. V. 6 is the first full vision of the Elect One in the heavenly court — all agents agree on "Elect One of righteousness and of faith." "Under the wings" (v. 7) retained from all agents — a powerful and theologically significant image. See disagreement log for decisions on vv. 1, 2, 10.*
